title: The Mandalorian & His Allies to the Rescue
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: With Grogu captured by Moff Gideon, the Mandalorian puts together a crack team to infiltrate Gideon's cruiser and take back the being he cares most about. Bo-Katan Kryze, Koska Reeves, Boba Fett, and Fennec Shand join Mando in the fight, but things go wrong when the Dark Troopers are released. As the Dark Troopers move in on them, a mysterious figure boards the ship, cutting a path through the Droid soldiers.
